findings.title: Liquidation Charges Fixed and Floating
findings.root_cause: After a venue liquidation repays debt (including accrued floating interest) from borrower collateral, _rebase derives the floating leg from the remaining live venue debt and erases the already-paid floating cost, so it is never charged to the solver bond and the borrower pays both fixed and floating.

findings.title: Delayed Rebase Falsely Slashes Solver Bond
findings.root_cause: _accrueLegs runs before _rebase, so after a permissionless Morpho partial liquidation of the Pod interest is accrued on debt already repaid, inflating negative spread until the solver bond becomes liquidatable; the borrower can trigger this and profit.

findings.title: _accrueLegsView() over-accrues surplus on pre-liquidation Aave collateral and _rebase() converts the overage into solver owned yield
findings.root_cause: Surplus is accrued on stale stored collateral before live venue collateral is synced, so after a partial Aave liquidation yield is booked on seized collateral and _rebase's split charges that excess to the borrower's principal as solver surplus.

findings.title: setAuthorizationWithSig() lets stale signed grants restore revoked operators
findings.root_cause: Signed authorisations only check that the nonce is unused, so an older unused isAuthorized=true signature can be replayed after a direct revoke to restore a removed operator.

findings.title: Borrowers can flash-wash tracked collateral to steal solver Aave yield
findings.root_cause: Iris ignores live Aave collateral above tracked Position.collateral, so a borrower can supply directly to Aave on the Pod's behalf and withdraw the same amount through Iris, shrinking tracked collateral so future yield on it escapes the solver.
